description: Curated openCypher TCK-style read-only scenarios that Coral claims for virtual graph execution. These scenarios are synthetic and run end-to-end through Cypher parsing, graph validation, SQL lowering, DataFusion execution, and result comparison.

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age >= 30 AND p.active = true RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city IN ['London', 'Paris'] RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age < 30 OR p.city = 'Paris' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT p.active RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH 'A' OR p.name CONTAINS 'ar' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name =~ 'A.*' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.active XOR p.city = 'Paris' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 'Person' IN labels(p) AND NOT ('Service' IN labels(p)) RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 'city' IN keys(p) AND NOT ('missing' IN keys(p)) RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE exists(p.city) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE p.age < friend.age RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) WITH a, b WHERE a.age < b.age RETURN a.name AS younger, b.name AS older ORDER BY younger, older
MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) WITH a, b WHERE id(a) = id(b) RETURN a.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p, friend WHERE friend IS NULL RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age % 2 = 0 RETURN p.name AS name, p.age % 2 AS remainder
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age + 1 > 40 RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE p.age > friend.age - 5 RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE (p.active = true AND p.city = 'London') OR (p.active = false AND p.city = '') RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (a:Person)-[k:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE k.since >= 2021 AND k.strength < 0.8 RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, k.since AS since ORDER BY since, source
MATCH (a:Person)-[k:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE k.strength >= 0.7 RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, k.strength AS strength ORDER BY strength DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 30 <= p.age <= 40 RETURN p.name AS name, p.age AS age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.active RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name <> 'Bob' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city = '' RETURN p.name AS name, p.city AS city
MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE r.since >= 2021 RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, r.since AS since ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (target:Person)<-[:KNOWS]-(source:Person) RETURN source.name AS source, target.name AS target ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (p) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) RETURN a.name AS left, b.name AS right ORDER BY left, right
MATCH (a:Person) MATCH (b:Person) RETURN a.name AS left, b.name AS right ORDER BY left, right
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS left, b.name AS right ORDER BY left, right
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(c:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS middle, c.name AS target ORDER BY source, middle, target
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person), (b)-[:KNOWS]->(c:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS middle, c.name AS target ORDER BY source, middle, target
MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, r.since AS since, r.strength AS strength ORDER BY since
MATCH (:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(target:Person) RETURN target.name AS target, r.since AS since ORDER BY target, since
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, a.age AS sourceAge, b.name AS target, b.city AS targetCity ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(a) RETURN a.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) RETURN count(*) AS relationships
MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(a) RETURN a.name AS name

expected.contains: variable 'r' is bound more than once

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p, friend WHERE friend IS NULL RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, coalesce(friend.name, 'none') AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE friend.city = 'Paris' RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS paris_friend ORDER BY person, paris_friend
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE r.since > 2025 RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, r.since AS since ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, r.since AS since ORDER BY person, since
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, count(friend) AS friend_count ORDER BY friend_count DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE r.strength >= 0.7 RETURN p.name AS person, count(r) AS strong_count ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:KNOWS]-(source:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, source.name AS source ORDER BY person, source

MATCH (p:Person), (target:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Alice', 'Bob'] AND target.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(target) RETURN p.name AS person, target.name AS target, r.since AS since ORDER BY person, target

MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(outgoing:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:KNOWS]-(incoming:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, outgoing.name AS outgoing, incoming.name AS incoming ORDER BY person, outgoing, incoming
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) MATCH (friend)-[:KNOWS]->(foaf:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, foaf.name AS foaf ORDER BY person, friend, foaf
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS {since: 2022}]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, r.strength AS strength ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH path = (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, length(path) AS hops ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, count(friend) AS friend_count ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS people, sum(p.age) AS age_sum, min(p.age) AS youngest, max(p.age) AS oldest
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(({kind: 'person'}).kind) AS literal_count, sum(({age: p.age + 1}).age) AS adjusted_age, min(({age: p.age}).age) AS youngest
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p.city) AS city_count
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(*) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN avg(p.age) AS average_age, median(p.age) AS median_age, stDev(p.age) AS sample_age_stdev, stDevP(p.age) AS population_age_stdev
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN percentileCont(p.age, 0.75) AS p75_age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name <> 'Alice' RETURN stDevP(DISTINCT toFloat(p.age)) AS population_age_stdev
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.active AS active ORDER BY count(*) DESC, active
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p.name AS person, count(friend) AS friend_count WHERE friend_count > 1 RETURN person, friend_count
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } AS friend_count ORDER BY friend_count DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN friend.name } AS friend_count ORDER BY friend_count DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } AS active_states ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 1 < COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 1 < COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] RETURN p.name AS person, COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN friend.name } AS friend_names ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) RETURN DISTINCT 'friend' } AS friend_markers

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE isEmpty(COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE friend.name = 'Bob' RETURN friend.name }) RETURN p.name AS person, size(COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active }) AS active_friend_states ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.name } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(foaf:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, coalesce(foaf.name, 'none') AS friend_of_friend ORDER BY person, friend_of_friend
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, CASE WHEN p.active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS status ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, CASE p.city WHEN 'London' THEN 'local' WHEN 'Paris' THEN 'remote' WHEN '' THEN 'missing' ELSE 'other' END AS city_bucket ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE CASE p.city WHEN '' THEN 'missing' ELSE p.city END <> 'missing' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age >= CASE WHEN p.active THEN 34 ELSE 30 END RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, CASE p.city WHEN '' THEN null ELSE p.city END AS city_or_null ORDER BY name

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend, CASE WHEN r.strength >= 0.8 THEN 'strong' WHEN r.since >= 2021 THEN 'recent' ELSE 'weak' END AS relation_bucket ORDER BY relation_bucket, person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.city = '' THEN 0 WHEN p.city = 'London' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN true AND true AS tt, true AND false AS tf, false AND true AS ft, false AND false AS ff
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN true OR true AS tt, true OR false AS tf, false OR true AS ft, false OR false AS ff
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN true XOR true AS tt, true XOR false AS tf, false XOR true AS ft, false XOR false AS ff
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN NOT true AS nt, NOT false AS nf, NOT NOT true AS nnt, NOT NOT false AS nnf

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN true OR true AND false AS and_before_or, (true OR true) AND false AS grouped_or_first, false AND true OR true AS left_and_before_or, false AND (true OR true) AS grouped_or_right
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN (true OR false) AND false AS grouped_false, true OR (false AND false) AS grouped_true, NOT (true OR false) AS not_or, NOT (true AND false) AS not_and
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, p.active XOR p.city = 'Paris' AS active_xor_paris ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, NOT (p.active OR p.city = 'Paris') AS neither_active_nor_paris, NOT p.active AND NOT (p.city = 'Paris') AS expanded ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, (p.active AND p.age > 30) OR p.city = '' AS eligible, p.active AND (p.age > 30 OR p.city = '') AS active_qualifies ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.age AND p.active AS invalid_bool
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.age = 34 AS equals_int, p.age = 34.0 AS equals_float, p.age <> 29 AS not_bob_age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name = 'Alice' AS name_matches, p.city = 'London' AS city_matches, p.city <> 'Paris' AS city_not_paris
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.age > 30 AS gt_30, p.age < 40 AS lt_40, p.age >= 34 AS gte_34, p.age <= 34 AS lte_34, p.age < 29 AS lt_29
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name < 'Bob' AS name_before_bob, p.city > 'Lisbon' AS city_after_lisbon, p.city <= 'London' AS city_lte_london, p.city >= 'Paris' AS city_gte_paris
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.active = true AS active_is_true, p.active <> false AS active_not_false, p.active = false AS active_is_false
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE a.name = 'Alice' AND b.name = 'Bob' RETURN a.age > b.age AS source_older, a.name < b.name AS name_before_friend, a.active <> b.active AS active_differs
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN friend.name AS friend, r.since >= 2021 AS since_at_least_2021, r.strength < 0.8 AS strength_below_eight ORDER BY friend
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, 30 < p.age <= 34 AS in_alice_range ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, 'A' <= p.name < 'Carol' AS before_carol ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE WHEN p.active THEN p.name ELSE p.age END AS mixed_case
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE p.city WHEN 'London' THEN 1 ELSE p.city END AS mixed_case
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, 'person' AS kind, 42 AS answer, 1.5 AS score, true AS literal_flag, null AS missing ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [1, 2, 3] AS ints, ['a', 'b'] AS strings, [true, false] AS flags
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE coalesce(null, 'prod') = 'prod' AND null IS NULL AND nullIf('prod', 'prod') IS NULL RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE coalesce(nullIf(p.city, ''), 'missing') = 'missing' RETURN p.name AS name, coalesce(nullIf(p.city, ''), 'missing') AS normalized_city
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, p.city IS NULL AS city_is_null, p.city IS NOT NULL AS city_is_not_null ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN null IS NULL AS literal_is_null, null IS NOT NULL AS literal_is_not_null
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN {known: true}.missing IS NULL AS missing_is_null, {known: null}.known IS NULL AS explicit_is_null, {known: true}.known IS NOT NULL AS known_is_not_null
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, coalesce(null, nullIf(p.city, ''), nullIf(p.name, p.name), 'missing') AS city_or_missing ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Bob' RETURN coalesce(null, p.city, 'missing') AS city
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name, null + 1 AS null_plus_one, p.age + null AS age_plus_null, null * p.age AS null_times_age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name, toString(null) AS null_text, abs(null) AS null_abs, sqrt(null) AS null_sqrt
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.age > null AS age_gt_null

expected.contains: null can only be compared with equality or inequality

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE friend.name = 'Nobody' RETURN p.name AS name, r IS NULL AS rel_is_null, friend.name IS NULL AS friend_name_is_null, friend.name IS NOT NULL AS friend_name_is_not_null ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE null = null RETURN p.name AS name

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN keys({name: p.name, age: p.age}) AS map_keys, head(keys({first: 1, second: 2})) AS first_key, 'city' IN keys({city: p.city, active: p.active}) AS has_city_key
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE ({active: true}).active = p.active RETURN ({name: 'static'}).name AS dotted, {rank: 7}['rank'] AS indexed, {known: true}.missing AS missing ORDER BY {sort: 'constant'}['sort']

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE {active: p.active}['active'] = true RETURN ({name: p.name}).name AS name, {city: p.city}['city'] AS city, ({upper_city: toUpper(p.city)}).upper_city AS upper_city ORDER BY ({sort: p.age}).sort DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE properties(p).active = true RETURN properties(p).name AS name, properties(p).city AS city ORDER BY properties(p).age DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p['active'] = true RETURN p['name'] AS name, properties(p)['city'] AS city ORDER BY p['age'] DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN range(1, 3) AS numbers, split('red,blue', ',') AS colors, size(range(1, 3)) AS number_count
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY range(1, 2), split('red,blue', ','), toStringList([1, 2]) DESC

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN ['a', 'b', 'c'][1] AS second, ['a', 'b', 'c'][0..2] AS first_two, head(['a', 'b']) AS first, last(['a', 'b']) AS last_value, tail(['a', 'b', 'c']) AS tail_values
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE all(x IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE x > 0) AND any(city IN ['London', 'Rome'] WHERE city = 'London') AND p.city = 'London' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE x > 1 | x + 1] AS incremented, [city IN split('London,Paris', ',') | toUpper(city)] AS city_codes
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [1, 2, null] | pow(x, 2)] AS powers, [x IN [2, 3] | power(x, 2)] AS squares

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [0, 1, null] | round(exp(x), 0)] AS exponentials, [x IN [1.0, 2.718281828459045, null] | round(ln(x), 0)] AS natural_logs, [x IN [1, 100, null] | log10(x)] AS base10_logs, [x IN [1, 2] | round(pi(), x)] AS rounded_pi, [x IN [1, 2] | round(e(), x)] AS rounded_e

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [0.0, 1.5707963267948966] | round(sin(x), 0)] AS sines, [x IN [0.0, 1.5707963267948966] | round(cos(x), 0)] AS cosines, [x IN [1.0] | round(atan2(x, x), 2)] AS arctangent_pairs, [x IN [3.141592653589793] | round(degrees(x), 0)] AS degree_values, [x IN [180.0] | round(radians(x), 2)] AS radian_values, [x IN [0.0] | haversin(x)] AS haversines

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, [k IN coalesce(keys(friend), ['fallback', 'unused'])[0..1] | toUpper(k)] AS first_friend_key, [k IN (CASE WHEN friend IS NULL THEN ['fallback', 'unused'] ELSE keys(friend) END)[1..3] | k] AS middle_friend_keys ORDER BY person

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, [k IN coalesce(keys(friend), ['fallback', 'unused'])[0..1] | k] = ['active'] AS first_key_is_active, 'city' IN [k IN (CASE WHEN friend IS NULL THEN ['fallback', 'unused'] ELSE keys(friend) END)[1..3] | k] AS middle_keys_include_city ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN reduce(total = 0, x IN range(1, 3) | total + x) AS total, reduce(found = false, city IN ['Paris', 'London'] | found OR city = 'London') AS city_seen
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN filter(city IN split('London,Paris,Rome', ',') WHERE city <> 'Rome') AS cities, extract(x IN filter(x IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE x > 1) | x * 10) AS scores
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, [(p)-[knows:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE knows.since >= 2021 | friend.name] AS recent_friends ORDER BY name

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE isEmpty([(p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE friend.name = 'Bob' | friend]) RETURN p.name AS person, size([(p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) | friend]) AS friend_count ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE isEmpty(p.city) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, isEmpty(p.city) AS city_empty ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toUpper(p.name) = 'ALICE' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, toLower(p.city) AS city_lower ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, left(p.name, 3) AS name_prefix ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, right(p.city, 2) AS city_suffix ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name='Alice' RETURN lpad(p.name,10,'*') AS pl, rpad(p.city,8,'-') AS pr

MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, trim('  padded  ') AS trimmed, lTrim('  left') AS left_trimmed, rTrim('right  ') AS right_trimmed ORDER BY name

MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, substring(p.name, 1) AS name_tail ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city STARTS WITH '' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city ENDS WITH '' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city CONTAINS '' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT p.name STARTS WITH 'A' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT p.name ENDS WITH 'e' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT p.name CONTAINS 'o' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH 'A' AND p.name CONTAINS 'i' AND p.name ENDS WITH 'e' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN reverse('raksO') AS reversed
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, abs(p.age - 35) AS d ORDER BY d, name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE ceil(p.age * 0.1) = 4.0 AND floor(p.age * 0.1) = 3.0 AND round(p.age * 0.1, 1) = 3.4 RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE sqrt(abs(p.age - 25)) > 3.0 AND sign(p.age - 34) > 0 RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, round(p.age / 3.0) AS rounded_age_thirds ORDER BY name
